## Description of Changes

Provide a clear and concise description of what this PR does and why.

## Type of Change

Select all that apply:

- [ ] **New skill** — Adding a new Agent Skill to the repository
- [ ] **Skill improvement** — Enhancing an existing skill's content or functionality
- [ ] **Bug fix** — Fixing a broken script, link, or validation issue
- [ ] **Documentation** — Updating docs, README, or architecture documentation
- [ ] **Translation** — Adding or updating a translated README

## Checklist

Before submitting this PR, confirm the following:

- [ ] My `SKILL.md` follows the [required format specification](docs/skill-format.md) (if adding/modifying a skill)
- [ ] I have run `bash scripts/validate-skills.sh` and all skills pass validation
- [ ] My changes do not include secrets, API keys, credentials, or sensitive information
- [ ] I have added/updated translations where applicable (see [Translation Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md#translation-guide))
- [ ] I have read and agree to the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

## Related Issues

Link any related issues here (e.g., `Closes #42`, `Fixes #17`).

## Screenshots / Examples

If applicable, add screenshots or example output demonstrating the change.
